snippet.title: Age of Pirates   Wind Basics
snippet.description:
Play Age of Pirates for free: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tresebrothers.games.ageofpiratesrpg

Using the prevailing winds to your advantage is a critical skill for a sea faring captain.  This video tutorial covers some of the basics of sailing with or across the wind and explains why this so important for a successful captain.
